description: Land Title Settlement Department  -Mallawapitiya, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District   - Cad. Map No. 420201
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in Mallawapitiya. It contains detailed schedules with parcel numbers, owner names, extents, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters. The content falls under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it primarily concerns land registration, title determination, and property ownership details without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
